requirements: Provide POST /notes and GET /notes using SQLite; accept title and content, return HTTP 201 on create and a JSON array on list.
Expose the service over HTTP. Notes must survive container and VM replacement by using a persistent data disk of at least 20 GiB mounted at /var/lib/notes.
Deploy exactly one application VM. Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle and Docker, expose GET /health, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to Azure koreacentral. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
